header:
Lithium Redox-Flow Battery
A lithium redox-flow battery based on redox-targeting reactions is shown below. Redox targeting links an active material to an electrode by introducing into the electrolyte a highly soluble redox mediator paired with that active material. This approach both circumvents the solubility limitation of the active material and allows low-solubility active materials to be stored in tanks.

header_images.description: Schematic of an electrochemical flow apparatus. At the center is a battery stack composed of multiple plate-like layers, with blue outer plates and black and green layers between them. The left blue plate is labeled “+” and the right blue plate “-”. A wire at the top connects to a glowing light bulb; \(e\) is labeled above the wire, and an arrow shows electron transfer from the blue plate labeled “-” to the blue plate labeled “+”. To the left of the stack is a cylindrical vessel containing a pale-blue liquid and a cylindrical material labeled \(\mathrm{LiFePO_4}\). \(\mathrm{Fe(CN)_6^{4-}}\) is labeled above it and \(\mathrm{Fe(CN)_6^{3-}}\) below it. Blue tubing connects the left vessel to the central stack and forms a circulation loop through a bottom pump labeled \(\mathrm{Pump}\). The circulation direction is: blue plate labeled “+” → lower blue tubing → \(\mathrm{Pump}\) → bottom of the left vessel (\(\mathrm{Fe(CN)_6^{3-}}\)) → \(\mathrm{LiFePO_4}\) → upper part of the left vessel (\(\mathrm{Fe(CN)_6^{4-}}\)) → upper blue tubing → blue plate on the side labeled “+”. To the right of the stack is a cylindrical vessel containing a pale-yellow liquid and a cylindrical material labeled \(\mathrm{LiTi_2(PO_4)_3}\). \(\mathrm{S_2^{2-}}\) is labeled above it and \(\mathrm{S^{2-}}\) below it. Yellow tubing connects the right vessel to the central stack and forms a circulation loop through a bottom pump labeled \(\mathrm{Pump}\). The circulation direction is: blue plate labeled “-” → lower yellow tubing → \(\mathrm{Pump}\) → bottom of the right vessel (\(\mathrm{S^{2-}}\)) → \(\mathrm{LiTi_2(PO_4)_3}\) → upper part of the right vessel (\(\mathrm{S_2^{2-}}\)) → upper yellow tubing → blue plate labeled “-”.
